title: Azure Build got stuck in the "Install dependencies" stage under "Test vstest"
author: divyagayathri-hcl
body:
Team,
The Azure Build got stuck in the "Install dependencies" stage under "Test vstest".
I could observe the same error in all the PRs raised from yesterday evening (25 March 2026).

**Failure Logs:**
[https://dev.azure.com/mssonic/build/_build/results?buildId=1071344&view=logs&j=3f6395b2-1619-5ebe-f305-2aedcf353cb5&t=f9db2383-9349-50ba-61c3-4bde15cec59e](https://dev.azure.com/mssonic/build/_build/results?buildId=1071344&view=logs&j=3f6395b2-1619-5ebe-f305-2aedcf353cb5&t=f9db2383-9349-50ba-61c3-4bde15cec59e)

[https://dev.azure.com/mssonic/build/_build/results?buildId=1071626&view=logs&j=3f6395b2-1619-5ebe-f305-2aedcf353cb5&t=f9db2383-9349-50ba-61c3-4bde15cec59e](https://dev.azure.com/mssonic/build/_build/results?buildId=1071626&view=logs&j=3f6395b2-1619-5ebe-f305-2aedcf353cb5&t=f9db2383-9349-50ba-61c3-4bde15cec59e)

Thanks.
